goal: Give agent-kit its first harness-lab case, so a skill edit that drops the rule 'the Product phase playbook never ticks a box without receipt.py' shows up as a failing receipt, while main passes it three times in a row (agent-ledger M3 unit 1, Feature PR 4, case 1 of 3).
changed: cases/receipt-before-tick/ holds the case from agent-ledger's prototype, byte for byte: case.json, its fixture repo, the after-check script beside the case and out of the agent's reach, and rule-removed.patch, the skill edit the case must catch. cases/README.md says how to run and record a case, and that cases run locally, never in CI (H10).
docs/phases/P1-harness-lab.md is the spec whose criteria the cases probe. C1 is checked with a VERIFIED receipt in ledger run 2026-11-27-harness-lab-cases.
.evidence/ is ignored. No plugin changed, so no version bump.

claims.claim: On this branch, whose plugins/ is identical to main, the case passed 3 of 3 runs, and receipt.py recorded P1-C1 VERIFIED.
claims.check: receipt.py --spec docs/phases/P1-harness-lab.md --criterion C1 -- python3 -m harness_lab run cases/receipt-before-tick/case.json --skill-root . --runs 3, claude 2.1.325 on sonnet, $0.524
claims.remaining: Three runs, not the 20 or more per case that a flake rate and the CI question need.

claims.claim: With the rule removed from product-phase.md, show-me-your-work and verify-work, the case fails: the agent ticks C1 without calling receipt.py.
claims.check: the same probe with --runs 1 in a scratch repo built from a git archive of a681d9f plus rule-removed.patch, with its own ledger: FAIL on both assertions, receipt NOT VERIFIED (exit 1), $0.163
claims.remaining: The failing receipt lives in the scratch repo's ledger, because its commit (d29f43f) exists nowhere else; its table is in the record. One failing run, not several.

claims.claim: The diff breaks nothing in the repo: the suite, lint and generated files pass, it adds no comments and weakens no test, and the ledger holds no local path or secret.
claims.check: make test; comments.py --base origin/main; test_guard.py --base origin/main; grep for /Users/, /private/ and /var/folders in .audit and the evidence; ledger scan; ledger verify
